ranks: Darksteel (DST, 2004-02-06): whole set, 102 (the third middle walk's range); built "and all other permanents with the same name as that permanent" (condition:same-name-as-target — CardFilter.sameNameAsTarget, rule 201.2a), with the ten earlier cards it unblocked (Maelstrom Pulse, Detention Sphere, Bile Blight, Declaration in Stone, Deputy of Detention, Banishment, Sever the Bloodline, Homing Lightning, Izzet Staticaster, Wake of Destruction) and twelve earlier ones re-triaged to what still blocks them

blocked.name: Death Cloud
blocked.why: The sacrifice effect's count is a fixed number; 'each player sacrifices X creatures / X lands' can't be said.

blocked.name: Surestrike Trident
blocked.why: The granted ability's cost includes 'Unattach Surestrike Trident'; no ability cost unattaches.

blocked.name: Hallow
blocked.why: Nothing prevents all damage a target spell would deal, gaining life equal to the damage prevented.

blocked.name: Dismantle
blocked.why: The counter kind (+1/+1 or charge) is chosen as it resolves, and the destroyed artifact's counter total can't be read inside the choice.

blocked.name: Emissary of Hope
blocked.why: countOf can't count the artifacts the damaged player controls (controlledBy takes only you/opponent/active-player).

blocked.name: Thought Dissector
blocked.why: reveal-until has no 'or X cards are revealed, whichever comes first' limit.

blocked.name: Arcbound Overseer
blocked.why: Modular is two plain abilities with no keyword marker, so no filter finds 'creatures you control with modular'.

blocked.name: Leonin Bola
blocked.why: No ability cost unattaches the source Equipment in the ability it grants.

blocked.name: Neurok Transmuter
blocked.why: Nothing removes the artifact type until end of turn (removeTypes is static-only; animate's setTypes would wipe other types).

blocked.name: Pulse of the Grid
blocked.why: No condition checks whether an opponent has more cards in hand than you.

blocked.name: Pulse of the Fields
blocked.why: The life-total condition compares only with a fixed number, not with your own life.

blocked.name: Unforge
blocked.why: Nothing reads what the target Equipment was attached to as it was destroyed.

blocked.name: Aether Snap
blocked.why: remove-counter removes one named kind from one permanent; nothing removes every counter from every permanent.

blocked.name: Serum Powder
blocked.why: Nothing lets a card act from the hand while a mulligan is decided.

blocked.name: Chittering Rats
blocked.why: look-and-choose from a hand can't be aimed at a targeted opponent (the opponent chooses a card from their own hand).

blocked.name: Emissary of Despair
blocked.why: countOf can't count the artifacts the damaged player controls.

blocked.name: Pulse of the Forge
blocked.why: No condition compares the targeted player's (or planeswalker controller's) life with yours.

blocked.name: Pulse of the Dross
blocked.why: Nothing makes a player reveal three cards of their choice for you to pick from, and the hand-size comparison is missing.

blocked.name: Turn the Tables
blocked.why: Combat damage to you can't be redirected to a target creature.

blocked.name: Death-Mask Duplicant
blocked.why: Nothing grants the keywords of linked exiled cards; only their activated abilities can be granted.

blocked.name: Panoptic Mirror
blocked.why: 'Copy a card exiled with this artifact' is one chosen card; cast-now from exiled-with-source copies every imprinted card in turn.

blocked.name: Heartseeker
blocked.why: The granted ability's cost '{T}, Unattach Heartseeker' has no AbilityCost field.

blocked.name: Flamebreak
blocked.why: damage-all has no 'creatures dealt damage this way can't be regenerated this turn' rider.

blocked.name: Test of Faith
blocked.why: A prevent-damage shield has no '+1/+1 counter for each 1 damage prevented this way' rider.

blocked.name: Auriok Siege Sled
blocked.why: No combat restriction is tied to one particular attacker: neither 'blocks this creature if able' nor 'can't block this creature'.

blocked.name: Rebuking Ceremony
blocked.why: When both artifacts have one owner, that owner orders them on top (the ruling); two put-on-library steps fix the caster's target order instead.

blocked.name: Eater of Days
blocked.why: No effect skips turns; this card skips two.

blocked.name: Lich's Tomb
blocked.why: cantLoseGame is broader than 'don't lose for having 0 or less life'.

blocked.name: Tears of Rage
blocked.why: A delayed sacrifice can't refer to 'those creatures' the pump affected.

blocked.name: Thunderstaff
blocked.why: Damage replacements prevent all of the damage only; a -1 reduction isn't prevention.

blocked.name: Second Sight
blocked.why: look-and-choose can't look at a target opponent's library for you to reorder.

blocked.name: Murderous Spoils
blocked.why: No way to gain control of the Equipment that were attached to the destroyed target.

blocked.name: Scrounge
blocked.why: No shape where the target opponent picks from their own graveyard and the card enters under your control.

blocked.name: Tanglewalker
blocked.why: No 'can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an artifact land' condition (not true landwalk).

blocked.name: Legion's End
blocked.why: Re-triaged after sameNameAsTarget (B214): the battlefield part is buildable, but the cards with that name in the player's hand and graveyard aren't — the clause binds a battlefield -all effect only.

blocked.name: Secret Salvage
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): search the library for cards with the target graveyard card's name — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Mask of the Mimic
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): a library search for the target's name — sameNameAsTarget isn't bound in a search.

blocked.name: Moratorium Stone
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): graveyard cards with the target card's name — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Echoing Return
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): the namesakes are graveyard cards — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Rat King, Verminister
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): the namesakes are graveyard cards — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Legions to Ashes
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): 'the target and all tokens with its name' — a filter can't say 'is the target, or a token sharing its name'.

blocked.name: March of Burgeoning Life
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): a library search for the target's name — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Hour of Glory
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): the namesakes are cards in the player's hand — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Crumble to Dust
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): the namesakes are in graveyard, hand and library — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only.

blocked.name: Mimeofacture
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): a search of the target's controller's library for its name — sameNameAsTarget isn't bound in a search.

blocked.name: Tibalt's Trickery
blocked.why: Re-triaged (B214): 'a nonland card with a different name than that spell', revealed from a library — sameNameAsTarget is bound for battlefield -all effects only; and the countered spell's controller casts it.
